answer:
The biggest time gap between the 30‑39‑year‑old men’s and women’s division winners was in **2015**.

| Year | 30‑39 Male winner | Time | 30‑39 Female winner | Time | Difference |
|------|-------------------|------|---------------------|------|------------|
| 2015 | Ben Moreau | 00:42:37 | Jane Fardell | 51:03 | 8 min 26 s |
| 2016 | Thomas Do Canto | 00:43:08 | Cassandra Fien | 47:21 | 4 min 13 s |
| 2017 | Thomas Do Canto | 00:42:14 | Marnie Ponton | 48:49 | 6 min 35 s |
| 2018 | Ben St Lawrence | 00:41:35 | Marnie Ponton | 47:53 | 6 min 18 s |
| 2019 | Liam Adams | 00:40:56 | Tara Palm | 47:05 | 6 min 09 s |

**Largest difference:** 2015, 8 min 26 s.  

Sources  
- 2015 male winner: https://results.timingsports.com/list/city2surf/2015/14KM/ (row 3: “BEN MOREAU … 00:42:37 … M30‑39”).  
- 2015 female winner: https://au.raceview.net/race/50453?category=F30-39 (rank 1: “Jane Fardell … 51:03”).  
- 2016 male/female winners: https://results.timingsports.com/list/city2surf/2016/14KM/ (rows 2 & 34).  
- 2017 male/female winners: https://results.timingsports.com/list/city2surf/2017/14KM/ (rows 2 & 54).  
- 2018 male/female winners: https://results.timingsports.com/list/city2surf/2018/14KM/ (rows 1 & 44).  
- 2019 male/female winners: https://results.timingsports.com/list/city2surf/2019/14KM/ (rows 2 & 35).
